7 انزبق He entered (IKh, IF, S, K) into a house, or tent, or chamber; (IKh, IF, K;) and he entered into it and concealed himself: (TA:) [quasi-pass. of زَبَقَ, or] formed by transposition from انزقب. (S, TA.) And [simply] He hid, or concealed, himself. (TA.) ―
-b2- And انزبق فِى الحِبَالَةِ He became caught, or entangled, in the snare. (Lh, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
